_doc: The health log (game/health/health_log.gd) and the F9 monitor (ui/health_panel.gd). long_frame_ms: a frame over this is told as slow (50 ms: the long-task threshold of the W3C Long Tasks API; the game's own rule 'no frame over 50 ms'); status_window_s how far back the dot looks; kept entries in the ring, kept_saved of them written for the next session every save_every_s; rows on the panel. step_min_ms: a section of the frame this long is named in a slow frame's detail.
